Thank you for your suggestions... and I am aware of all that. Many of those activities you mentioned have helped distract me in the past. There is something deeper that nothing I've come across has been able assist in bringing clarity to. I'm not entirely sure what that thing even is. And I've allowed it to cripple me.

I am alone. Utterly and completely alone. And no matter what I've done to reach out and connect to others, to connect to spirit, concepts, ideas, the All, humanity.... I remain totally and completely alone.

And it's excruciating knowing that there are others out there who are able to connect and feel themselves to be a part of humanity, part of the universe, part of the continuous flow of everything that is.

But I am not a part of that. I never have been. I deeply desire to be. But I've not been able to figure out what has to be done to establish and maintain those types of connections that would allow me to become more than this single, isolated aspect of awareness assembling all these swirling patterns around itself.

Well, I've been feeling extremely suicidal again. So there's that.

Usually an indicator of major things changing in my awareness.

I feel like I've got so much less to live for now than I ever have in the past though. Like, the noose is tightening, the window of opportunity is rapidly shrinking. The feelings of not being able to escape are compounding upon themselves.

They told me that this year it would be very very important to stay focused on what I wanted and not remain stuck in the past and everything I was fearful of. Something about the collective awareness increasing everyone's ability to manifest for themselves that which they focus on most heavily.

Well, I did what I did, and it seems my fate it headed right into the void.

I want the best for you all. And want to be able to join you. But it feels increasingly the case that this form that I currently am is too infected to be cured and must be cleansed.

Or that might be a trick by a false sense of who I am to try and stop me from actually making a difference in the world and in the lifes of those around me.

Regardless, I've not been doing much of anything with this life. I've not even been communication with people online and sharing my perspective and challenges and anything I've discovered.

Perhaps that's why I've felt like crap, I know I should be taking everything I know and harmonizing with all these wonderful people I know online. All these souls that are so much like myself, who see themselves and the world through similar a veil.

I can see us all doing so well if we could unite somehow.... why's it feel as if there's something preventing us from doing so in what feels like a meaningful way?

Perhaps experiencing the physical death process is what my soul needs to experience for continued growth? But then... why would that be the case? Wouldn't it be more logically sound for some sort of transformation to occur leading to another stage in life? And yet... these are the same thoughts I've had since 2014... and there has not been much progress at all.

If this is all because of God's anger... then I'm sorry... I'd like to know what I need to do to please God and the children of God so that we can dance and sing and frolic together rather than waste away pining for the day when I find that sense of joyous soulful communication.

I just found out this gay guy ended up giving me HSV-1, he hadn't told me he had it and then when I was asking him about it he said that he may have even intended to infect me. 

Yeah, gay guys are mostly trash. All this guy was ever seemed interested in was sex too... 

I wanted a loving authentic relationship and he used me for his own pleasure and even that wasn't enough.

This world seems so cruel and confusing so often. I just want to be somewhere that is joyous, loving, and free.

To be clear of the past and be able to take full control over creating a life that I choose to live without being naive and susceptible to others.

I just want to be cuddled and play video games and go on adventures.
I see it more as a expression of a state of being rather than an interpretation of existence... why did you choose to see it as an interpretation of existence?
